articleTitle: Homomorphic Encryption Algorithms for Online Furniture Customization Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the continuous development of cryptographic technology, there are solutions for information and data confidentiality in many industries. The online furniture industry has brought new modes of industry transactions and interactions to the global furniture industry. However, the confidentiality and sharing of information and data play a crucial role in determining whether the online furniture industry can operate in a regulated manner and thrive. This study delves into the confidentiality and sharing of sensitive data and private information of designers and customers in online furniture platforms, examining the use of homomorphic encryption algorithms in this process and providing a detailed description and analysis of the process. The ultimate goal of this study is to provide references for relevant applications in this field.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling and Solving Stochastic Equations in Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: This paper investigates the stochastic characteristics in large-scale distributed information systems. By analyzing random phenomena such as system failures, network delays, and server loads, corresponding mathematical models are established. A hierarchical and progressive HSRA (Hierarchical Stochastic Response Analysis) solving framework is designed, incorporating core solving methods like the improved Metropolis-Hastings algorithm, particle filtering, and LSTM neural networks. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model excels in tasks such as failure prediction, delay prediction, and load prediction. Through parallel acceleration optimization, the system’s processing capacity is significantly enhanced while maintaining a high level of resource utilization. The research findings provide effective theoretical and technical support for the reliability assessment and performance optimization of information systems.

articleTitle: Specific Design and Implementation of the Characteristic Species Database in Wuling Mountain Area
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: This article aims to design and implement a database system for characteristic species in the Wuling Mountain area. The system will collect, organize, store, and analyze information on characteristic species in the Wuling Mountain area, providing data support for ecological research, biodiversity conservation, agricultural production, and other fields. This article will provide a detailed introduction to database requirements analysis, data model design, database structure implementation, data security management, and system testing and optimization.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Deep Learning-based Anomaly Detection System for Industrial Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of industrial equipment fault prediction, a deep learning-based equipment fault prediction and health management system is designed and developed. The system collects equipment operating data from multiple sources, establishes an equipment health evaluation model, and achieves fault prediction and diagnosis. The test results show that the system’s fault identification accuracy reaches $\mathbf{9 5. 8 \%}$, and the warning accuracy is $\mathbf{9 4. 3 \%}$. After six months of application in a petrochemical enterprise, the average fault interval time of the equipment is increased by 44%, and the maintenance cost is reduced by $\mathbf{3 2. 6 \%}$, achieving significant economic benefits.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Vehicle Collaborative Control System under Intelligent Connected Environment for New Energy Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: This paper systematically tests and analyzes the vehicle-road collaborative autonomous driving system. A complete test environment, including on-board equipment, roadside units, and communication networks, was built in a professional closed test field to carry out comprehensive functional performance evaluation. Typical scenario tests, such as vehicle collaborative platooning, communication handover, and obstacle avoidance, were conducted to verify the system’s functionality and reliability. Continuous testing was performed on key performance indicators such as real-time performance, stability, and resource utilization, with comparative analysis against existing mainstream systems. The test results show that the system has significant advantages in communication performance, control accuracy, and system latency, meeting the expected design goals and satisfying practical application requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Storage Optimization of Distributed Ledgers Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: This work proposes a complete set of optimization techniques that improve the performance of distributed ledger technology (DLT) systems over cloud storage environments under big data conditions and experimentally verifies several strategies’ efficiency in regard to storage and consistency. First, at the storage level, a compression optimization method manages to drastically reduce the occupied space by DLT data. Experimental results show that an appropriate compression ratio can improve storage efficiency and effectively manage access delay to maintain the overall responsiveness of the system. In terms of data consistency strategies, it uses an eventual consistency strategy that can be used to guarantee data reliability and consistency to achieve a DXGI-level throughput improvement. This approach will be able to satisfy the real-time responsiveness and accuracy of data of DLT systems in big data scenarios while further optimizing resource utilization. Furthermore, the comparison of several experimental results can show how different optimization strategies influence some key metrics, such as storage efficiency, access delay, throughput, and consistency, under different parameter settings. These findings serve both a theoretical and practical foundation for DLT systems that can work more efficiently in cloud environments. The result of this research carries high values in showing lessons for the future cloud storage optimization of DLT, and also lays a foundation for its wider application and promotion in big data-driven scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Information Technology on the Construction of Intelligent Engineering Audit Systems in Accounting Firms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the application of intelligent technology in audit work, the engineering audit system has ushered in new development opportunities, prompting major accounting firms to actively explore the construction and application of intelligent information technology in engineering audits. To this end, this paper, from the perspective of engineering audits conducted by accounting firms, takes the five stages of engineering audits in accounting firms as the main thread to study the overall framework of the intelligent engineering audit system and the specific design of each stage. It also analyzes the application of the intelligent engineering audit system through practical cases. The application results show that compared with traditional manual identification, efficiency has been improved by 80%, the average audit reduction rate per project for auditors has increased by $\mathbf{2 0 \%}$, and the average audit duration has been reduced by $\mathbf{3 5 \%}$.

articleTitle: Research on Recommendation Algorithm for Short Video Health Content Targeting Elderly Users
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: To achieve precise delivery of health-related short videos to elderly users, this paper proposes a real-time recommendation method based on a knowledge graph. This method integrates both short-term and long-term interests of elderly users, designing an efficient algorithm to capture and streamline short-term interests. By leveraging users’ recent interactive behaviors and the node relationships within the knowledge graph, it rapidly extracts health topics of concern. Additionally, an interest fusion mechanism is developed, which combines long-term interests (extracted through knowledge graph mining) with short-term interests (obtained through streamlined representation). Weighted summation or an attention mechanism is employed to dynamically adjust the weights, enabling personalized recommendations and enhancing efficiency and accuracy. Experimental results indicate that the accuracy and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) of the proposed algorithm are $85.19 \%$ and $85.09 \%$, respectively, demonstrating its high precision. Moreover, the algorithm maintains the highest F1 score and accuracy across all predefined recommendation lengths.

articleTitle: Time-varying neural networks based on local attention mechanism for time series forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: To address the challenges of long-range dependency capture and local dynamics sensitivity in time series prediction, this study proposes a novel time-varying neural network (LATVN) based on the local attention mechanism. The design of the LATVN focuses on mitigating the gradient vanishing problem and enhancing the model’s sensitivity to the local dynamics in the time series. The model efficiently captures key temporal dependencies by focusing on specific parts of the sequence through local attention blocks (LA blocks). Meanwhile, the time-varying structure allows the model parameters to be dynamically adjusted over time steps, thus better adapting to the non-stationary and cyclical changes in the time series. Extensive experimental evaluations on several standard datasets show that LATVN outperforms existing baseline methods in several evaluation metrics, proving its effectiveness and superiority in time series forecasting tasks. The proposal of LATVN provides new perspectives and solutions in the field of time series forecasting, and it is expected to demonstrate its forecasting potentials in a wider range of application scenarios.

articleTitle: Optimization of Aircraft Trajectory Design Based on Intelligent Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes an adaptive trajectory optimization algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to address the issues of low computational efficiency and poor environmental adaptability in aircraft trajectory optimization. The algorithm constructs a multi-layer neural network model and incorporates an improved policy gradient method to achieve real-time trajectory planning in complex environments. A dynamic reward mechanism and hierarchical decision structure are introduced, effectively enhancing the system’s adaptability to extreme weather and sudden disturbances. Large-scale testing and verification on a high-precision simulation platform demonstrate that the proposed algorithm outperforms traditional methods in terms of computational efficiency, optimization performance, and system stability, with significant engineering application value.

articleTitle: Research on the Innovation and Development of Traditional Music Based on New Digital Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In order to improve the coordinated development of music and digital technology, this paper combines digital technology with music innovation to establish an automatic music generation model. Moreover, this paper establishes the management and control system of digital music, so that the production, dissemination and consumption of music can be standardized and connected, and the standards of each link can be established to provide a high-quality environment for music creators. The music automatic generation algorithm is realized based on composition rules and adopts IRL and DRL as training models, wherein the combination of composition rules and DRL enables the algorithm to generate harmony conforming to various application scenarios. In addition, this paper verifies that the music generation model based on new digital technology can meet the needs of modern music innovation and development. At the same time, with the update of science and technology, the integration of music with it will be deeper and deeper, and the combination of audio-visual is only the beginning. Therefore, the future music art may also combine hearing from the perspectives of touch, smell and taste, so as to make the three-dimensional effect of the music scene better.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low-Power Electronic Information Communication Protocol for the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: This paper addresses the energy consumption issues in IoT applications by designing a low-power communication protocol. The protocol employs a four-layer architecture, which includes key technologies such as power control at the physical layer, dynamic sleep/wake mechanisms at the MAC layer, energy-aware routing at the network layer, and data compression at the application layer. Through cross-layer optimization design, a collaborative energy-saving mechanism is achieved across the protocol layers. The main innovations of the protocol lie in the dynamic duty cycle sleep/wake mechanism, hybrid data compression scheme, and energy-aware routing algorithm. Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in key performance indicators, such as energy consumption, latency, and throughput, compared to traditional protocols. Under scenarios involving network scale expansion and environmental interference, the protocol exhibits good adaptability, providing effective technical support for lowpower designs in the IoT.

articleTitle: EUnet++: Enhanced Unet++ Architecture Incorporating 3DCNN and CBAM Modules for Brain Tumor Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Brain tumor segmentation plays a crucial role in medical imaging, aiding in accurate diagnosis and treatment planning. This paper proposes EUnet++, an enhanced Unet++ architecture incorporating 3D Convolutional Neural Networks (3DCNN) and Convolutional Block Attention Modules (CBAM) to improve segmentation accuracy. The 3DCNN module enhances the model’s ability to capture spatial features, while CBAM focuses attention on critical tumor regions for better segmentation performance. Through ablation studies, comparative experiments, and visualizations, the study show that EUnet++ outperforms traditional models in terms of segmentation precision, particularly in capturing complex tumor boundaries and fine details. These findings underscore the potential of EUnet++ in advancing brain tumor segmentation tasks in clinical applications.

articleTitle: Research on Image Signal Enhancement and Denoising Algorithms for Intelligent Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: The quality of image signals directly affects the performance of intelligent communication systems. This paper proposes a set of image enhancement and denoising algorithms to address image quality degradation in intelligent communication systems. For image enhancement, we designed an adaptive histogram equalization algorithm based on blocks and a contrast adaptive optimization method, and implemented a detail enhancement algorithm combining multi-scale edge detection and enhancement. In terms of image denoising, we proposed adaptive median filtering, improved soft-threshold wavelet domain denoising, and non-local means algorithms to effectively suppress various types of noise. The system is developed using a hybrid $\mathrm{C}++$ and Python framework with parallel processing achieved through multithreading technology. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithms significantly improve image quality, processing efficiency, and system stability, providing reliable image signal processing support for intelligent communication systems.

articleTitle: Research on the Effectiveness of Human-Machine Collaborative Teaching Based on Data Analysis in the Era of Digital Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In the era of digital intelligence, the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into educational practices has the potential to transform traditional teaching methods. Human-machine collaborative teaching (HMCT) is a new paradigm that leverages the strengths of both human educators and AI tools to enhance learning outcomes. This study investigates the effectiveness of three human-machine collaborative teaching strategies—directive, guided, and collaborative-implemented in a university—level software engineering course. The experiment involved 99 third-year students and aimed to evaluate the impact of these teaching strategies on creativity and academic performance. The results show that the collaborative teaching method, enhanced by generative AI tools, led to the highest performance in final exams and overall academic achievement, as well as increased participation in extracurricular innovation activities in homework. While directive teaching produced consistent results, it did not foster the same level of engagement or creativity. Guided teaching demonstrated moderate success, but the greatest benefits were observed in the collaborative approach, where students took an active role in their learning. This study suggests that integrating AI into collaborative learning environments can enhance both academic outcomes and student creativity, and recommends expanding the use of AI-supported strategies in higher education. Future research should explore the scalability of these findings across disciplines and investigate long-term impacts on student development and career readiness.

articleTitle: A Study on a 3D Model Plagiarism Detection Method Based on Point Cloud Features
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a 3D model plagiarism detection method based on point cloud feature analysis to address complex model modification scenarios such as local deformation, geometric distortion, and non-uniform scaling. By converting 3D models into point cloud representations and incorporating an improved Siamese network architecture, the method leverages attention mechanisms and feature fusion strategies to capture geometric similarities and differences between models from both global and local perspectives. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method consistently achieves high performance across various transformation scenarios, particularly exhibiting significant advantages in non-uniform scaling cases where traditional digital watermarking and zero-watermarking methods perform poorly. These findings confirm the applicability and robustness of the proposed approach in 3D model copyright protection.

articleTitle: Real-time Monitoring System for Large-scale Data Processing in Cloud Computing Environment: A Research Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: To meet the real-time processing demands of large-scale e-commerce transaction data, a distributed data processing system was designed and implemented. The system utilizes an improved LZ4 compression algorithm and micro-batch processing mechanism to optimize data transmission efficiency and computing performance. A 25-node cluster environment was set up for performance testing, and the system achieved a single-node processing capacity of 56,700 transactions per second and an overall processing capacity of $\mathbf{8 9, 0 0 0}$ transactions per second. After six months of deployment on a certain e-commerce platform, the system processed an average of 500 million transactions per day, with an $\mathbf{8 5 \%}$ increase in accurate identification of abnormal orders and a system availability of $\mathbf{9 9. 9 9 \%}$, achieving high-efficiency and stable data processing.

articleTitle: Research on Indifference Management of Differentiated Computer Room
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: University computer rooms generally prefer batch purchasing strategy to simplify the management process such as system deployment and software update. However, with the growth of the life of the equipment, the failure of electronic products is inevitable, especially once the motherboard problem occurs, it is often difficult to find a replacement that exactly matches the original motherboard. Even if the replacement is found, its price is far beyond the market average level. After several years of operation, even the motherboard purchased in the same batch may also lead to the coexistence of a variety of models due to various reasons. In this situation, it becomes impractical to carry out unified network cloning. To solve this problem, we propose an innovative solution: deploying a local backup system combined with a server-controlled startup mode. The core of this solution is that through the local backup system, we can effectively deal with the challenge of different motherboard models, and ensure that each machine can have its own system snapshot. At the same time, the server-controlled boot mode further enhances the flexibility and efficiency of management, so that even in the hardware diversity of the environment, it can also achieve batch system recovery. The introduction of local backup system not only solves the problem of differentiated computer room management, but also significantly improves the convenience and stability of computer room operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Research on Network Security Threat Detection and Defense Mechanism Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the openness, anonymity and cross-border characteristics of cyberspace, network security incidents occur frequently, and the network security challenges in the era of artificial intelligence (AI) are becoming increasingly severe. This paper analyzes the application of AI technology in improving the accuracy and efficiency of network intrusion detection, constructing adaptive defense mechanism and data leakage prevention strategy. The theoretical basis relies on machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL) and reinforcement learning (RL), which provide mathematical and algorithmic support for building an efficient and intelligent network security system. This paper designs a comprehensive network security threat detection and defense system framework, including network traffic data preprocessing, feature extraction, malware detection, network abnormal behavior identification and defense strategy optimization. The experimental results show that the model based on DL has achieved high accuracy in malware detection and network abnormal behavior identification, while the defense strategy optimized by Q-learning has effectively reduced the attack success rate and false alarm rate.

articleTitle: Hardware-Software Co-Design of the Lightweight Authenticated Encryption Algorithm ASCON for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet of Things (IoT) technology, the popularity of smart devices poses new challenges to data security. ASCON algorithm is an ideal choice for IoT applications because of its lightweight characteristics and excellent security performance. This paper first summarizes the basic principle of ASCON algorithm and its position in NIST lightweight encryption standard, and then introduces the goal and implementation strategy of its software and hardware co-design in detail. By designing an efficient hardware IP core and optimizing the software implementation, this paper significantly improves the encryption processing speed, reduces the memory occupation and optimizes the energy efficiency. The test results show that the co-design of hardware and software not only improves the performance stability of ASCON algorithm, but also provides a more solid security guarantee for IoT devices, laying a foundation for future smart device applications.

articleTitle: Study on Feature Extraction and Classification Optimization Methods for Malware Detection Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimization method for feature extraction and classification in malware detection. By selecting the optimal feature subset, designing a deep learning classification model, and introducing focal loss to solve the sample imbalance problem, the proposed method improves the detection accuracy. Experimental results show that the residual connection mechanism improves the model performance by 0.7%, and the feature weighting strategy further improves the detection effect by 1.2%. The optimized model achieves a detection accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8. 7 \%}$, which is 3.3% higher than the baseline model, demonstrating its good application value.

articleTitle: Language shadow- Based on An Improved Spatiotemporal Network Model Lip Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Lip recognition technology is of great significance, but the traditional technology has limitations such as low accuracy, poor real-time and poor visualization. This study developed a lip recognition system based on an improved spatiotemporal network model. Fusion YOLOv7, algorithm, improved TSM-ResNet50 model and Flask framework construction innovative scheme: using YOLOv7 to detect lip position accurately; improved TSM-ResNet50 combines multiple modules and mechanisms to improve the dynamic recognition ability of lip; Flask framework for visualization and interaction. The experiment shows that the system achieves high accuracy and real-time lip recognition, can accurately locate lip position, identify action and visual display, and supports offline and online real-time video recognition. It has broad application prospects in special education, public security, and other fields and has social and commercial value.At the same time, the project details the marketing strategy, business model, financial analysis, and various risk control measures. The comprehensive implementation is expected to promote the development and application of lip recognition technology, bringing a positive impact.

articleTitle: Research on the Role of Artificial Intelligence Technology in the Construction of Accounting Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) technology, as the mainstream technology currently used to enhance social production efficiency, strengthen domain management capabilities, and simplify social production methods, demonstrates significant application value in multiple fields. In the construction of accounting information systems, the integration of AI technology can further improve the level of automation and intelligence in this field, strengthen accounting work efficiency, enhance the authenticity of accounting information, reduce accounting management risks, and increase the practical application value of accounting. Therefore, this paper, from a theoretical perspective, summarizes and elaborates the current research status of the role of AI technology in the construction of accounting information systems and related theories to clarify the research subject and direction. It also intuitively introduces the specific role of AI technology in the construction of accounting information systems and adopts case studies to verify the practical application value of the research from a practical case perspective, comprehensively reflecting the significance and value of the research and further providing references for similar studies.

articleTitle: Time-Frequency Analysis for Non-Stationary Time Series Based on Adaptive Window
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Time-frequency distribution is an important tool for analyzing time series, yet the application of traditional methods in non-stationary time series is constrained by their inherent limitations. This paper proposes a method that integrates the autoregressive model, the dynamic linear model, and adaptive windowing, enabling the dynamic partitioning of non-stationary time series into a series of locally stationary process. Within these segments, the relationship between the regression coefficients of the AR model and the frequency components is established. Simulation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach in identifying locally stationary processes and extracting frequency components. Compared to the ShortTime Fourier Transform (STFT), our method can significantly enhance the concentration of the estimated time-frequency distribution. Furthermore, since the windows obtained by our method do not overlap in time, it avoids the aliasing phenomenon that often occurs in STFT due to windowing.

articleTitle: Management of Intelligent Detection and Growth Cycle Prediction Model for Fruit and Vegetable Growth Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: The goal of this research is to create an advanced prediction and forecasting system for fruits and vegetables using deep learning to enhance agricultural production management efficiency and accuracy. By combining a convolutional neural network (CNN) and a long short-term memory network (LSTM), an accurate prediction of the ripening stages of fruits and vegetables is achieved by leveraging image data and environmental conditions. The proposed model attains an accuracy prediction of $\mathbf{9 4. 5 \%}$ in the trial findings, along with a system response time of 2.3 seconds and a user satisfaction rate of $\mathbf{8 7. 2 \%}$. Moreover, the design of the system includes data collection, data analysis, predictive modeling, and user interaction functionalities to maintain system scalability and reliability. This research offers both a scientific answer for monitoring fruit and vegetable growth and technical assistance for future smart agricultural management, showcasing the potential of deep learning technology in agriculture.

articleTitle: Research on Modification of the Initial Pose Estimation Algorithm for ORB-SLAM2
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: ORB-SLAM2 has been widely used in computer vision applications. To overcome the limitations in the initial pose estimation step in complex scenes, this paper proposes an adaptive threshold strategy to modify the constant velocity motion model. In addition, the RANSAC strategy is incorporated into initial pose estimation. The experiments on the complex EuRoC public dataset show that the modified strategy can improve the location and pose estimation of the ORB-SLAM2 system in terms of efficiency and accuracy to some extent.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Electronic Data Retrieval in Material Supply Chain Enhanced by Large Language Models and Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In response to the new goals of building green and modern smart supply chains, the electric power equipment supply chain is experiencing a shift toward digital intelligence and low-carbon, environmentally friendly development [1]. However, traditional search platforms based on relational databases face challenges in handling vast amounts of multimodal electronic data. These platforms often suffer from low search accuracy, limited cross-dimensional correlation analysis capabilities, and inefficiencies, making them inadequate for constructing comprehensive big data platforms that integrate and share information across the entire green, modern, smart supply chain. This paper introduces an innovative electronic data retrieval method designed to meet the data retrieval needs of material supply chains. By integrating large language models with knowledge graph technology, it proposes an electronic data retrieval system that leverages vector database technology for text embedding of multimodal data. Additionally, artificial intelligence is used to enable knowledge retrieval and augmented generation, significantly enhancing data retrieval capabilities within the specialized domain of material supply chains.

articleTitle: Athlete Physical Fitness Assessment and Training Optimization Assisted by Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, the physical fitness assessment and training optimization of athletes have encountered a new revolution. This article mainly discusses the potential applications of artificial intelligence in athletes’ physical fitness assessment and training optimization and analyzes the limitations of current physical fitness assessment methods. Artificial intelligence systems can perform precise assessments of athletes’ physical condition in real time by integrating sensor data, sports physiology indicators, and individual biological information. Based on these assessment results, the system can design personalized training plans, optimize training loads, and recovery periods, thereby maximizing sports performance and reducing the risk of injuries. In addition, artificial intelligence can provide scientific evidence to help coaches and athletes develop more effective training strategies by analyzing historical data and physiological responses. Case studies have verified the effectiveness of the physical fitness assessment and training optimization method assisted by artificial intelligence, indicating that this technology can offer a new perspective for sports science research and promote the comprehensive development of athletes.

articleTitle: Research on Data Encryption and Privacy Protection Technologies in Cloud Computing Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: This study focuses on data encryption and privacy protection technologies in cloud computing environments. By systematically implementing and evaluating various encryption algorithms (such as AES, RSA, and homomorphic encryption) and privacy protection techniques (including data masking, differential privacy, secure multi-party computation, and zero-knowledge proofs), the feasibility and effectiveness of these technologies in cloud environments are explored. A simulated cloud environment was constructed for experiments, and the results indicate that AES performs excellently in large-scale data processing, while homomorphic encryption demonstrates unique advantages in specific scenarios. Privacy protection techniques can achieve a balance between protecting user privacy and maintaining data availability. System performance and security tests confirm that the proposed solutions effectively support the data security and privacy protection needs in large-scale cloud environments. This research provides a comprehensive technical implementation and evaluation reference for data security and privacy protection in cloud computing environments, while also highlighting some challenges and offering valuable insights for future research directions.

articleTitle: Improvement of Kalman Filtering in Mobile Robot Target Recognition and Intelligent Localization Research
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Addressing the challenge of depth information loss faced by monocular mobile robots in the process of target recognition and position estimation, and aiming to enhance localization accuracy, especially when integrating lidar for distance measurement, we propose an innovative Kalman filtering algorithm. This algorithm integrates radar ranging information with azimuth calculation results. Initially, the YOLO network is utilized for efficient target recognition, followed by the acquisition of target azimuth angle information through standard computer vision calibration techniques. On this basis, lidar is employed for multiple directional ranging to obtain multiple observations. During the calculation of the target position, different confidence weights are assigned to each observation based on its distance and direction information. These weights are used to dynamically adjust the observation noise and system noise of the Kalman filter, thereby optimizing the Kalman gain and achieving adaptive target position estimation. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through simulation experiments and practical tests. The results demonstrate that compared to traditional methods that solely rely on radar ranging for supplementation, our method achieves more accurate localization and exhibits broad application potential.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Warehouse Management and Automated Scheduling Based on Embedded Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of efficiency improvement and resource optimization in enterprise warehouse management, this paper designs and implements an automated scheduling system based on embedded control system. By analyzing the current status and shortcomings of the existing warehouse management system, the requirements of system design are clarified, and a modular architecture including perception layer, control layer and application layer is constructed. The system adopts a hybrid optimization algorithm, combining genetic algorithm and particle swarm optimization algorithm to optimize the scheduling decision process, and improves system performance through data compression and caching mechanism as well as real-time monitoring and fault prediction technology. Experimental results show that the automated scheduling system can maintain a low response time under different load conditions, and the optimized resource utilization rate is significantly improved in multiple key indicators. Research shows that the automated scheduling system based on embedded control system has significant advantages in improving warehouse management efficiency, optimizing resource allocation and reducing operating costs, and has broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Research on Real-time Monitoring and Control Method of Magnetic Levitation Flywheel Energy Storage Based on DPI Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Aiming at the stability control problem of magnetic levitation flywheel energy storage systems during high-speed operation, a displacement closed-loop control strategy suitable for multiple working conditions is designed, and a dual-processor hardware platform based on DSP+FPGA is developed. The speed control accuracy reaches 0.08%, and the radial displacement fluctuation is controlled within $\pm 20 \mu \mathrm{m}$. A fault diagnosis model is established, achieving a recognition accuracy of $\mathbf{9 6. 5 \%}$. System tests show that the system runs stably in the $0-15000 \mathrm{rpm}$ speed range, with a charge-discharge efficiency of $\mathbf{9 2 \%}$, meeting the requirements of engineering applications and having good engineering application value.

articleTitle: K-means Algorithm for Optimizing Initial Clustering Center Based on Density Peak
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: The K-means is sensitive to the initial choice of cluster centers, leading to the results to be different every time. To address this, a new K-means variant based on decision values is introduced. This approach incorporates the nearest neighbor concept when calculating decision values to ensure density correlation and improve clustering stability. Additionally, a revised method for local density calculation is proposed. With the predefined number of clusters, data points with higher decision values are automatically selected as centers, and the median of points in each cluster replaces the mean to reduce the influence of outliers. Experimental results show that this decision-based K-means algorithm (DPK) achieves stable performance, requires fewer iterations, demonstrates robust handling of outliers, and offers improved clustering accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Optimization Model of Complex System Reliability and System Availability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In this paper, the collaborative optimization model of complex system reliability and system availability is studied, aiming at solving the reliability and availability problems of key infrastructure such as cloud computing platform and intelligent transportation system in a highly information society. Firstly, this paper analyzes the reliability and availability characteristics of complex systems, and constructs a collaborative optimization model to achieve the optimal trade-off between system failure probability and system availability. The model selects the system’s failure probability, mean time to failure (MTTF), and mean time to repair (MTTR) as key indicators, integrating a weight coefficient to balance the importance of reliability and availability. Subsequently, this paper designs an optimization method based on Genetic Algorithm (GA), which involves encoding and initialization, fitness function calculation, selection, crossover, mutation operations, and the setting of termination conditions, to solve the model. Case studies demonstrate that through GA optimization, the system’s failure probability and availability have been significantly improved, validating the effectiveness and practicality of the model.

articleTitle: Onstruction and Security Performance Analysis of an Anti-Attack Optical Character Recognition (OCR) System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the widespread application of OCR technology in sensitive fields such as finance and healthcare, its security has become a pressing issue that needs to be addressed. In response to the multiple security challenges faced by current OCR systems, a comprehensive security enhancement scheme has been proposed. This scheme integrates multi-dimensional protection measures, including network layer micro-segmentation, application layer access control, and data layer full lifecycle encryption. Experimental data shows that the optimized system has significantly improved security, successfully defending against 99.97% of attack attempts, with a data integrity protection rate of $\mathbf{9 9. 9 9 9 9} \%$. The encryption communication scheme only adds a 0.5 ms delay, with a privacy protection accuracy of $\mathbf{9 9. 9 9 8 \%}$. This innovative scheme provides strong support for the deployment of OCR systems in high-security environments, promoting the further development of OCR technology.

articleTitle: Innovative Production of AI Digital Films and Applications of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: During the playback of moving shots in traditional 24FPS (Frames Per Second) films, stuttering and flickering often occur, significantly affecting the audience’s viewing experience. To effectively address this issue, it is necessary to increase the frame rate to 70FPS. However, the current film industry lacks an interpolation technique specifically tailored to the characteristics of films. To this end, this study proposes an AI-based film frame interpolation algorithm that integrates motion modeling and motion feature algorithms to ensure that the interpolated frames are consistent with the original frames before interpolation. This algorithm enhances the film’s frame rate while maintaining the consistency of the shot language. Simulation results demonstrate that this technology can effectively improve the quality and efficiency of the production process for high-tech format films, providing audiences with a unique viewing experience.

articleTitle: Research on Supply Chain Network Optimisation Based on the CNNs-BiLSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Supply chain management is becoming more and more crucial to corporate operations as the global economy grows quickly and market rivalry heats up. Traditional supply chain optimisation methods often have difficulty meeting the needs of complex market environments, especially when dealing with large amounts of nonlinear time-series data. To address this problem, this study proposes a deep learning model based on a combination of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and bidirectional long short-term memory networks (BiLSTMs), namely the CNNs-BiLSTM model, to improve the optimisation capability of supply chain networks. Experiments were conducted using real data from a large manufacturing company to evaluate the performance of the model and compare it with traditional single models. The experimental results show that the CNNs-BiLSTM model outperforms other models in terms of multiple key indicators such as accuracy, precision, recall and F1-score, demonstrating its effectiveness and adaptability in supply chain demand forecasting. The research results provide new perspectives and solutions for supply chain management, and have important theoretical and practical significance.

articleTitle: Application and Research of Large Language Model in Foreign Language Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology today, Large Language Model (LLM) has made significant progress in the field of language processing, particularly demonstrating immense potential in foreign language translation technology. This study aims to discuss the application of LLM in foreign language translation and analyze their profound impact on foreign language majors and talent cultivation. The article provides a detailed introduction to the technical background, current status, advantages, and limitations of LLM in translation. By comparing LLM with traditional translation technologies and combining specific practical cases, the practical application of LLM in professional translation fields is explored. Based on this, the study further analyzes the impact of LLM on the curriculum design, teaching methods, and student ability cultivation in foreign language majors, pointing out possible paths for the future development of foreign language majors. The research indicates that LLM not only enhances translation efficiency and accuracy but also drives changes in the educational model of foreign language majors, providing new ideas for cultivating foreign language talents that meet the demands of the new era.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Optimisation Model of Software System Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the scale of modern software systems and the rapid change of user requirements, system optimisation faces the dual challenges of dynamics and complexity. Traditional optimisation methods are difficult to meet the demands of current complex scenarios due to the lack of flexibility and real-time performance. To this end, this paper proposes an adaptive optimisation model for software systems based on reinforcement learning, which utilises the self-learning properties of reinforcement learning and the high-dimensional feature modelling capabilities of deep learning technology to design a set of solutions that can dynamically sense the changes in the environment and continuously optimise the system performance. The model solves the problem of multi-objective conflict in complex environments by constructing state space, action space and multi-objective reward mechanism, and achieves the dual goals of response time optimisation and resource utilisation enhancement. In addition, the model is experimentally verified in several dynamic scenarios in this paper, and the results show that the model significantly outperforms traditional methods in key indicators such as response time reduction rate and resource utilisation enhancement rate, which provides a new idea and practical support for the optimisation of software systems in complex dynamic environments.

articleTitle: Research on Software Defect Detection Model Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In this study, a neural network-based software defect detection model is proposed, aiming to address the limitations of traditional methods when facing complex code features and data imbalance problems. The model combines Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Attention Mechanism to achieve efficient modelling of code semantic information by extracting local structural features and global dependencies of the code. Meanwhile, the study introduces data enhancement techniques, including SMOTE oversampling and Gaussian noise injection, to improve the model’s detection ability and generalisation performance for minority class defective samples. The experiments are validated on NASA MDP and PROMISE datasets, and the results show that the proposed model significantly outperforms the traditional methods and the underlying neural network model in several metrics, such as precision rate, recall rate, F1 score and AUC value. In addition, the contribution of each component to the model performance is analysed through ablation experiments, demonstrating the effectiveness of the attention mechanism and data enhancement techniques. This study provides an intelligent, efficient solution with good generalisation capability for the software defect detection task, and at the same time provides new ideas and technical references for subsequent research.

articleTitle: Development of Multi-spectral Data Acquisition Imaging System for Power Transmission and Transformation Engineering of Rotary Wing UAV
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Rotary-wing UAV has important application value in the development of multi-spectral data acquisition imaging system for power transmission and transformation engineering construction. Nowadays, under the rapid development of science and technology, drones and micro-spectroscopy sensors have also made great progress. Because of its low cost, high efficiency, convenient use and good real-time performance, it is a new remote monitoring means, and in a sense, it can solve the defects of satellite remote sensing. In view of this, this study designed and developed a set of multi-spectral data acquisition imaging system suitable for rotary-wing UAV to meet the needs of power transmission and transformation engineering construction.

articleTitle: Application of UAV Multi-spectral Remote Sensing Technology in Vegetation Data Analysis of Power Transmission Project Construction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Objective: This study aims to investigate the application of UAV multispectral remote sensing technology in vegetation data analysis for power transmission and transformation engineering construction. It proposes protective measures for vegetation during the construction of power transmission and transformation projects, with the goal of providing reference for related engineering projects. Methods: By analyzing relevant data, the relationship between the vegetation types in permanent land occupation, temporary land occupation, and evaluation areas of high-voltage power transmission and transformation projects is explored. The study also compares the advantages of UAV multispectral remote sensing technology in data analysis with traditional manual statistics. Results: UAV remote sensing technology allows for detailed investigation of crop growth, pest and disease conditions, nutrition, moisture, etc., providing real and reliable crop information. Conclusion: UAV multispectral remote sensing technology, driven by advanced information technology, proves to be highly effective in vegetation data analysis for power transmission and transformation construction projects. It facilitates rapid, accurate, and objective analysis, offering significant advantages over traditional manual methods. These benefits include enhanced efficiency, improved objectivity, and greater authenticity, all of which contribute to more reliable and precise data for vegetation management in power transmission and transformation projects.

Author Keywords: power transmission and transformation engineering construction

articleTitle: Research on Digital Analysis Space Construction Technology for Ultra High Voltage Dense Transmission Channels
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Ultra high voltage transmission channels are important carriers for long-distance power transmission, but overly dense transmission channels pose challenges to the important carriers for long-distance power transmission, but overly dense transmission channels pose challenges to the safety of power entities. Therefore, it is necessary to extract the spatial safety boundaries of transmission channels and urgently analyze the spatial occupancy of power equipment. In urgently analyze the spatial occupancy of power equipment. In response to this issue, the article proposes a safety analysis method for ultra-high voltage dense transmission channels method for ultra-high voltage dense transmission channels based on digital space construction technology. Based on the information database of historical accidents, faults, hidden dangers, and operational status of ultra-high voltage dense dangers, and operational status of ultra-high voltage dense transmission channels, obtain practical data on the failure of the channel body in multiple disaster risks and service the channel body in multiple disaster risks and service environments. Design boundary condition partitioning rules for multiple risks and scenarios using techniques such as clustering analysis and Bayesian networks. Then analyze the for multiple risks and scenarios using techniques such as clustering analysis and Bayesian networks. Then analyze the composition of the power grid business and its main changing characteristics, and establish a multidimensional correlation model between environment risk and business based on the correlation data of environment risk business. In risk analysis and the operation of ultra-high voltage dense transmission channels, it is necessary to update the safety definition rules of and the operation of ultra-high voltage dense transmission channels, it is necessary to update the safety definition rules of the regional channel body in real time according to different the regional channel body in real time according to different purposes and needs. By using machine learning technology to deeply analyze real-time collected channel failure data, key indicators and corresponding judgment criteria can be deeply analyze real-time collected channel failure data, key indicators and corresponding judgment criteria can be adjusted to provide data support for channel emergency response and safety maintenance.

articleTitle: Research on Crop Disease and Pest Surveillance based on Big Data and Image Processing Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Recently, with the increasing complexity of agricultural systems and climate change, agricultural pest and disease surveillance and early detection have become critical tasks for guaranteeing food stability and promoting sustainable farming growth. Agricultural pest and disease surveillance is a key component of agricultural production, directly affecting crop yield and quality. As big data advances and image processing technologies rapidly, their application in crop pest and disease surveillance has become increasingly widespread. By integrating multi-source data, such as remote sensing data, meteorological data, ecological data, and pest and disease survey data, researchers can build more accurate and efficient pest and disease surveillance models. This paper reviews the research progress of big data and image processing technologies in crop pest and disease surveillance, analyzes the advantages and challenges of current technologies, and proposes future research directions to enhance the automation and intelligence of systems. Additionally, it discusses the integration of deep learning and other techniques to achieve efficient information mining and accurate retrieval of disaster-related data, aiming to provide scientific guidance and technical support for agricultural production.

articleTitle: Optimizing Unmanned Vessel Vision Systems for Biological Outbreak Prediction in Nuclear Power Plant Waters Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: As the importance of nuclear power plants as a source of clean energy continues to grow, the problem of biological outbreaks in the sea area of nuclear power plants poses a serious threat to their normal operation, especially as the proliferation of plankton may lead to the blockage of the cooling water system, thus affecting the safe operation of nuclear power plants. Traditional methods for predicting biological outbreaks often rely on manual observation and empirical judgement, which are difficult to meet the demand for efficient and real-time monitoring. For this reason, this study proposes an unmanned vessel vision system based on machine learning optimisation for the prediction of biological outbreaks in the sea area of nuclear power plants. By combining various machine learning algorithms such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, XGBoost and LightGBM, the system achieves efficient processing and fusion of multimodal data. The experimental results show that the integrated model performs well in terms of accuracy and advance warning time, which is significantly better than a single model, and is able to effectively predict biological outbreaks in complex marine environments. The successful application of the system demonstrates the strong potential of machine learning in environmental monitoring, while revealing its limitations in terms of cost and adaptability. Future research will focus on the further optimisation and wide application of the system to promote the development of intelligent environmental monitoring technologies.

articleTitle: Personalized Learning Path Recommendation Driven by Multi-Modal Knowledge Graphs and Large Models Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: This study examines ways to create personalized learning pathways that are influenced by large collaborative models and multi-modal knowledge graphs. By integrating multi-modal data to construct a comprehensive knowledge network, this study utilizes the generative and comprehension capabilities of large models to achieve personalized customization of learning resources. The focus of the research is on accurately depicting learner characteristics through multi-modal profiling techniques, ensuring the transparency and credibility of the content generated by large models. The personalized learning route suggestion model proposed in this paper includes two parts: recommendations for learning paths within courses and recommendations for learning paths within learning tasks, aiming to enhance learning efficiency and outcomes through the collaborative effects of multi-modal knowledge graphs and large models. Experimental results indicate that the learning path recommendation model driven by multi-modal knowledge graphs and large collaborative models performs excellently in improving learning outcomes and recommendation performance.

articleTitle: DT-ASGNRU: A Comprehensive Framework for Traffic Flow Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Traffic prediction plays a crucial role in alleviating congestion, enhancing road utilization, and reducing traffic accidents. In order to tackle the challenge of dynamic spatiotemporal correlations in traffic data, this paper introduces a new traffic flow prediction model, DT-ASGNRU. This model combines Gated Recurrent Units (GRU), a multi-attention mechanism, and a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN), while introducing an expansion convolution layer to enhance the multi-attention mechanism. This modification expands the acceptance domain, which enhances the model’s capacity to grasp local temporal dependencies. The expanded convolution based on multi-head attention mechanism enhances the sensitivity of the model to time series data and captures the temporal correlation in traffic flow effectively. Additionally, the integration of attention mechanisms with graph convolutions allows for dynamic modeling of spatial relationships within traffic networks. We conducted assessment trials utilizing an extensive collection of genuine traffic information, and the outcomes indicate that DT-ASGNRU surpasses all comparative methodologies in terms of performance.

articleTitle: Design and Validation of Attention Training Game Based on Eye Tracking Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of digital technology and the explosion of information, individuals are facing increasingly severe problems of distraction. However, most attention-related training adopts structured and standardized tasks and pays little attention to the design of the training content itself, which lacks interest and attractiveness and makes it difficult to maintain user engagement and persistence. In this paper, we propose the design principles and application framework of an eye-movement interaction attention training system for the characteristics of attention processing mechanism and eye-movement interaction mode, and based on this, we design an eye-movement interaction attention training game application. The training effect of attention was evaluated and tested by visual search task and training experience questionnaire. The results showed that eye-movement interaction training improved the subjects’ attention level.

articleTitle: Construction of a Deep Learning-Based Model for Assessing College Students’ Employment Ability and Predicting Trends
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: The rapid evolution of the job market, influenced by technological advancements and changing industry demands, has led to a growing need for more accurate tools to assess and predict the employability of college students. Traditional methods of employability evaluation, often relying on static indicators such as academic scores, fail to capture the dynamic and multifaceted nature of student potential. This paper introduces a hybrid deep learning model that combines academic performance, extracurricular activities, internship experience, and social media engagement to provide a comprehensive employability assessment. By integrating these diverse data sources, the proposed model not only evaluates individual employability scores but also predicts employment trends across various industries, offering valuable insights into future labor market shifts. The experimental results demonstrate that the hybrid model significantly outperforms conventional machine learning algorithms in terms of accuracy, with a higher R-squared value and lower error rates. Additionally, the interpretability of the model, through feature importance analysis, highlights key factors such as GPA, internship experience, and social media activity, which strongly influence employability predictions. This research provides important implications for universities, employers, and students by helping them make informed decisions in navigating the evolving job market.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Robot Target Recognition Systems Driven by Deep Learning Algorithms and the Optimization of Intelligent Localization Technology Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Robot target recognition and intelligent positioning technologies are widely applied in industrial production, logistics transportation, service robots, and other fields. However, they still face challenges in terms of stability in dynamic environments and accuracy in complex scenarios. To address these issues, this study designs an optimized algorithm that integrates multimodal data, combining a convolutional neural network (CNN) with a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework to construct an efficient target recognition and path planning system. To improve recognition accuracy, multi-scale feature fusion and an attention mechanism are introduced to enhance the model’s adaptability to small targets. In terms of positioning, an improved reward function and data fusion mechanism are employed to achieve better positioning accuracy and path smoothness. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves target recognition accuracies of $\mathbf{9 1. 6 \%}, \mathbf{9 4. 5 \%}$, and $\mathbf{9 6. 8} \%$ for small, medium, and large targets, respectively, in complex backgrounds. Localization error analysis reveals that the mean absolute error for small targets is 0.058 meters, while it is only 0.027 meters for large targets in complex backgrounds. In path planning tasks, compared to the BP-CNN algorithm, the optimized algorithm improves path smoothness by $\mathbf{2 2. 3 \%}$, reduces response time by 15.8%, and achieves a real-time response rate of $\mathbf{9 3. 4 \%}$ in complex environments. In summary, the proposed method demonstrates strong target recognition and positioning capabilities in complex environments, providing robust support for the further development of intelligent robot technology. There is still room for improvement in the recognition and robustness optimization of small targets in complex scenarios.

articleTitle: Optimized Resource Scheduling for Open Source Mobile Network Heterogeneous Computing Engines: A Comparative Study of DRF and H-DRF Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of the communications and computer industries, the demand for efficient data processing has surged. Single-processor architectures struggle to meet the high communication rate requirements of technologies such as V2X and AI, leading to a shift towards heterogeneous computing. Although heterogeneous computing improves data processing speed, it exacerbates the resource allocation problem. To address the shortcomings of the DRF scheduling method, this paper proposes an H-DRF scheduling approach based on DRF. Subsequently, it provides a conceptual framework for implementing H-DRF. To prevent issues such as project resource allocation failures and the allocation of critical resources, a weighting parameter is introduced to adjust the resource share ratios. An algorithmic approach is then outlined, and the H-DRF scheduling method is implemented in MATLAB. The performance of DRF and H-DRF is compared by allocating resources under identical system resources and project demands, leading to a conclusion. Finally, a comparative analysis of various parameters involved in the resource allocation process using DRF and H-DRF is conducted, explaining the superiority of H-DRF over DRF. Under the same conditions, H-DRF achieves higher resource utilization and better task throughput.
